title: Replace header logo placeholder with the user-provided logo image

requirements.text: Replace the current header logo placeholder (scissors icon) with the user-uploaded logo image file (1770202565370.png), and display it in the site header branding area in a clean, responsive way that matches the existing premium theme.
acceptanceCriteria: The header no longer shows the scissors placeholder icon; it shows the logo from 1770202565370.png instead.
The logo is sized appropriately for the existing header height (does not overflow or cause layout shifts) on mobile and desktop.
The logo includes meaningful alt text in English (e.g., "Baba Farid Tailor logo").
If the logo image fails to load for any reason, a reasonable fallback is shown (e.g., the existing placeholder component or a text-only fallback) without breaking layout.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be modified: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not route or serve images via the backend; use static frontend assets.
nonGoals: Do not change site navigation structure, sections, or copy beyond what is required to swap the logo.
Do not implement new authentication, backend storage, or other new features unrelated to the logo swap.
